item.title: Small Kitchen Counter: Organize Daily-Use Appliances
item.description: Most small kitchens do not have a storage problem so much as a decision problem. The coffee maker, the kettle, the toaster, the air fryer and the blender all got a spot on the counter one at a time, and now there is no room left to chop an onion. Moving them around rarely helps, because the real question is which of them deserve the counter at all. This guide gives you a way to decide.
